frozen_before: Any E014 community fit or changed community outcome
decision: Admit a separate provided-origin truth only after actual derivation/review/evaluator contracts pass. A GSA has publisher-known origins and exact source substrings; it need not pretend to be an alignment-derived unique-support truth.
relationship_to_prior_policy: The source-validation/provisional journals and source-admission-policy remain unchanged. Their unique-sequence support is not promoted. This explicitly scoped origin oracle is a prospective protocol amendment, not a silent relaxation or successful rewrite of those journals.
source_units: Exact publisher simulator genome IDs, each with every record in its provided source FASTA. Taxon IDs never merge source genomes. Source assemblies define evaluation groups; biological molecule/host annotations remain unknown. No biological plasmid-host claim.
targets: All799 abundance-positive oral provided genomes, all verified Bacteria, including the two absent from GSA. Full supplied-reference lengths, not observed spans or GSA eligibility, are denominators. All1057 source genomes/1410 records remain in the reference inventory.
support: For each contig, exact provided source interval and the publisher origin identify origin-oracle support. Count only localized ACGT query runs. Every non-ACGT base remains in full bin DNA and reference denominators but supplies no supported recovery.
ambiguity: Known identical cross-genome query DNA and shared complete reference records retain explicit flags/alternative-source evidence. Their primary support is called provided-origin, never unique DNA. A predeclared known-shared-mask sensitivity removes these query supports while retaining every bin/reference base. This sensitivity is not an exhaustive unique-support truth; partial, reverse, circular and near competitors remain unlocalized.
primary_metric: Per target, best bin with full-bin origin-supported purity>=.95 and full bin size>=200000bp; union source coordinates per provided record; divide by full provided genome length. Report weighted/macro origin-R95 and>=50%/>=90% counts. Keep E009's admitted conservative truth-v2 R95 separately named; no pooled cross-dataset score.
scope: Paired development/additional-community comparison, no unseen-genome, sequence-identifiability, assembly-error, measured-depth or MAG-quality claim. Exact reference overlap/species relatedness and historical/pretraining unknowns remain interpretation limits.
model_boundary: Only verified source-blind DNA, measured E009 parent depths and frozen marker evidence enter the science plan. All origins/taxonomy/reference K/truth thresholds remain evaluator-only.
review: Independently read every opaque model-input sequence, the retained reverse source join and derived truth row; verify exact IDs/DNA hashes/coordinates/runs/reference bounds/population/full denominators/accounting. Pass actual tiny recovery/quarantine/refusal contracts before admission. If any fails, preserve the journal and keep truth provisional.
